_notes: 'Hareket' for exercise, as the Turkish site and app say ('600+ hareket'). 'X nasıl yapılır?' and 'Çalışan kaslar' are the standard Turkish fitness headings; muscle pages are '{muscle} hareketleri' (the suffix sits on 'hareket', so every muscle name works; cf. Hürriyet's 'Sırt kanat hareketleri', yemek.com/listelist 'göğüs hareketleri'). The intro is label style because 'bileşik hareket' vs 'izolasyon hareketi' can't share one sentence template. Checked fitwill.app/tr, technopat/BodyForumTR wording; 'sen' register as on the site.
